# Margin machinery {#sec-margin}

A margin citation [@knuth84] should be rendered into the margin by the
TypeScript line processors in Quarto 1.

A footnote in prose.^[This footnote should land in the margin because of
`reference-location: margin`.]

![A figure with a footnote in its caption^[Caption footnotes get pulled out
by TS postprocessing.]](pixel.png){#fig-noted}

Code annotations:

```{.python}
def hello():          # <1>
    print("hello")    # <2>
```
1. The function definition.
2. The greeting itself.
